title: Download filename sanitizer strips paths, reserved names and overlength
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag prefixing an underscore to reserved names like CON.txt as mangling a legitimate file, or truncating the stem as data loss. Both are required for the stated contract: the original name cannot be created on the target filesystems at all, and truncation keeps the extension so the file stays openable.
